en:
{0E}"Hmph! This stupid thing! This stupid thing!
Back then! {0F}You wouldn't give it to me!{w}
note:
Cumulative re-display: {0E} part repeats rows 4117-4123 (slice 066); the English prefix must match whatever slice 066 used for those rows. Quote left open as in the source (it continues in 4127). [accuracy] {0E} redraw aligned to slice 066 4123 ("Hmph! This stupid thing! This stupid thing!
Back then!").

en:
{0E}"Hmph! This stupid thing! This stupid thing!
Back then! You wouldn't give it to me! {0F}And now you do!?"{w}
note: kusenitt = 'even though (you wouldn't back then)': rendered as 'And now you do!?' (what wasn't given = the approval/start stamp). Prefix must match slice 066 rows 4117-4123. [accuracy] {0E} redraw aligned to slice 066 4123 and to 4125.

en: "D-d-d-don't kick it! Noooooo!!"{w}
note: kekeke = stutter on keccha (kick). No mogu in the source here.

en:
"Well, if they absolutely insist,
I'll lend those guys a hand."{w}
"Not 'those guys'... you have to call them 'the gods'..."{w}

"Those guys are just as desperate to find that thing, aren't they?{w}They're probably letting it keep existing because they're counting on that chance."{w}{p}"In that case, I'll find it for them -- right here in my land."{w}
note: are = 'that thing' (unnamed); sonzoku = continued existence (of her land), referent kept vague as 'it'. [editorial] two "probably" in a row and stiff "go on existing"; "only" dropped (not in the source).

en: "Yay! So you're making up with the gods, Princess, mogu~"{w}

"No way!{w}In exchange, I'm going to have Father called back from the event horizon
and get Dehain banished in his place!"{w}
note: jisho no chihei = 'event horizon' (glossary). [accuracy] jishou no chihei = glossary "event horizon" (not Elm3 chihei-okuri "the Horizon").

en: "Waaah, waaah, waaaah!!{w}They'll hear you! The gods will hear you, moguuu!{w}They'll carve in the end time, moguuu!!"{w}
note: shuuryou jikoku = 'end time' (slice 030). 'it' = the land/inscription. [editorial] dangling "it" removed; matches slice 066 4087/4089 ("carved in", "the end time").

en:
"Shut up! If they can hear me, all the better!!
It's all getting recorded in Elminage anyway!{w}Isn't that right, Hisbert!?"{w}{p}"I won't lose!!"{w}{p}"To that slimy, bald, shithead bastard --
Dehain, I mean --
I will NEVER, EVER, EVER lose!!"{w}
note: inken hage unko yarou rendered at strength: 'slimy, bald, shithead bastard'.

en: "Eeeek! Eeeeeek!!{w}Th-th-that was a joke, mogu! It's not true, moguuu!!"{w}
note: uso mogu = 'it's a lie/not true' -- Raizam disowning Urna's words to the listening gods.

en: 'Die! Dehain, diiiie!'{w}
note: Source switches to double-bracket quotes for 4147-4159 (lines heard as they are recorded in Elminage); kept as single quotes.

en: 'Nwaaah!?{w}I'm sorry, I'm sorry, moguuu!!'{w}
"Pfft... Ahahahaha!!"{w}
'Make sure you record this properly, Hisbert!{w}Hey, Dehain!{w}Spew snot all over the place and drop dead!'{w}
'Eeeeeeeeeek!!!'{w}
"Yes, yes, I'm recording it.{w}Honestly. You really are full of energy.{w}If you can mouth off like that, you'll be fi..."{w}
note: Interrupted mid-word (daijou...) -> 'fi...'.

en: 'The old lady librarian will hear you, moguuu!!'{w}
note: obachan = 'old lady/auntie'; Hisbert repeats 'Old la...' in 4161. [editorial] word order ("librarian old lady"); "Old la..." in 4161 still echoes it.

en: "Old la...!?"{w}
"Heh... heh heh heh!!{w}Our little mole must be awfully fond of me, hmm?"{w}
note: moguro-kun -> 'our little mole' (no gender for Raizam).

en:
"Perhaps I should slip a bookmark in here
so I won't forget that remark~.{w}...Heh... heh heh heh heh!!"{w}

note: Three-line system box kept bordered; padding approximate. Item name 'Mysterious Bookmark' is new (fushigi na shiori). [prf] box padded so all three lines are 50 characters wide with centred text (right borders were at 44/48/50).

en:
There is an inscription.{w}{p}Mysterious numbers are carved into its surface.{w}{p}{0E}        *  714729.301  *        

            61045027  >{0F}{w}
note: Digits and layout copied (full-width -> ASCII, each full-width space -> two spaces); must match slice 066 rows 4082/4083. [accuracy] Number line aligned to slice 066 4083 (12 spaces, ">" in the same column as 4082). [editorial] narration prefix aligned to slice 066 4062 (identical Japanese). [prf] pages 1-2 realigned to slice 066 4062 / slice 065 SCD18:2845 (identical Japanese; 066 had moved to "There is an inscription." / "are carved into").

en:
"Before Contrachio was made,
I never felt like I was locked up,
but once it was built, the world suddenly went pitch black."{w}{p}"Pitch darkness whichever way I turned.{w}Nothing to touch, however far I reached out.{w}Not a sound, either."{w}{p}"I got... scared.{w}I couldn't help crying out,
but I couldn't even hear that."{w}{p}"I thought I'd died...{w}I was so frustrated that it ended like that..."{w}
"...I guess I kind of lost heart there for a bit...{w}and I cried!"{w}
note: [editorial] "got a little weak inside" was unidiomatic.

en:
"And then someone called out to me,
in this totally laid-back tone.{w}'Are you frustraaated?' they said!"{w}{p}"When I said of course I was,
I heard a voice say,
'Let us invest in your anger and sorrow.' I was like, 'Huh?'"{w}{p}"But the next moment,
everything opened up before my eyes,
and there was Zeshrom, in a dim place."{w}
note: yatsu (the laid-back voice) is unidentified: 'someone'/'they'. [editorial] last clause flowed flatly; "there was Zeshrom" for the reveal.

aitsu = Zeshrom (named in 4173); name used instead of a pronoun (glossary: no pronoun for Zeshrom). [editorial] Zeshrom = he (glossary male, script kare 4817; review_notes lets the editorial pass add pronouns): name repeated three times replaced; "showed off" -> "showed him".

en: There is an inscription.{w}If you go around to the front, you should be able to read it.{w}
note: Narration despite the speaker field. [editorial] first sentence aligned to 4062/4167 (identical Japanese); restores mawareba "go around to the front". [prf] first sentence realigned to 4062/4167/065 2845 ("There is an inscription.").

en: Creation Womb Palace{w}
note: New place name (soutaikyuu: creation + womb + palace).

en: "Do you need something, mogu?{w}This isn't a place you should be coming to, mogu."{w}{p}"Sorry, but I'd like you to go home, mogu.{w}If you won't, I'll send you home by force, mogu."{w}
"Goodbye, mogu.{w}Please don't ever come back, mogu."{w}
"Don't hurt the Princess any more than you already have, mogu!!"{w}
note: [editorial] source has plain mogu (not drawn out): "moguuu" -> "mogu", as in 4192.

en: "Y-you're strong, mogu...{w}But I won't let you get to the Princess, mogu!!"{w}
"You remembered the Princess, mogu.{w}But the Princess has gone into hiding, mogu.{w}Unless it's something really important, she won't see anyone but us, mogu..."{w}
"*Sniff sniff*...???{w}Th-that's Yuan Wine, mogu!?{w}There was still some left, mogu!?"{w}{p}"At Baroque Fort, you say...{w}Okay, mogu. Anyway, come with me, mogu!!"{w}
note: Baroque Fort: the party's off-screen answer is echoed.

en: "You've got some nerve, showing your face here.{w}This ain't a place for the likes of you."{w}{p}"If you don't wanna die, go home.{w}Right now, I've got no intention of going easy on you lot."{w}
"Get going, already!{w}Before I change my mind..."{w}
"Then I'll knock you flat!!"{w}
"Dammit, you're not bad...{w}But I'll protect the Princess even if it costs me my life!{w}Get outta here!!"{w}

note: kyoudai rendered 'family' (party gender unknown). kaishi no kokuin = 'start stamp' (slice 031). [editorial] "the same Princess's land" read as "the same Princess"; "This time too" unidiomatic; konkai koso = "this time for sure"; "God" -> "Gods" (review_notes: gods plural lowercase).
Encounter title banner; blank padding lines kept as spaces, centring approximate. masoukyoku = pun on chinkonkyoku (requiem).

en: In the darkness, two eyes blaze fiercely.{w}On finding you, they narrow, as if testing you.{w}{p}You cannot say why,{w}but without a word exchanged, you understand his thoughts.{w}{p}He is searching for his master.{w}If you know where, he will let you go.{w}If you don't, he will kill you.{w}{p}His master? How could you possibly know?{w}
note: 'he' follows the source's kare (a creature, not a named character). [editorial] bare "Why is it?" did not read; same wonder kept as "You cannot say why".
Encounter title banner (Spanish 'bullfight' kept).

en: A huge double-bladed axe comes spinning toward you.{w}Wielding it is a half-human, half-bull woman of steel.{w}
Commanding Voice
note: New name box (haki ni michita koe).

en: "Hah hah hah hah!!{w}What's with you lot and those puny bodies!!"{w}{p}"You'll never win a fight like that, you know?{w}Here, let me give you a little training.{w}Don't hold back. Come at me!"{w}
note: [editorial] two stacked fragments ("What's with you lot? What sorry excuses for bodies!!") -> one line.
Encounter title banner.

en: Posh Voice
note: New name box (serebu na koe).

en:
"Lured here by a fresh new land,
and what a lovely banquet I find."{w}{p}"Look, here comes the main dish.{w}Dripping blood and fat, that springy flesh... oh, simply irresistible...!"{w}{p}"Medium? Rare?{w}Hehe, ingredients this fine simply must be eaten raw!"{w}
note: [editorial] tamaranai = delight; "I can't stand it" could read as disgust.

en: *  Princess Territory  *
note: Area label.
Encounter title banner. taidou = quickening/stirring (as in a womb).

en: Clingy Princess
note: New name box (matowaritsuku hime).

en:
"It's hot, it's hot, what do I do?{w}I can't find Mirco anywhere,
and if I stay like this I'm gonna die."{w}{p}"When I find Mirco~,
I'll punch him and tie him up and killy-kill him~{w}Hafuu, it's so hot, I'm shriveling uuup."{w}{p}"Aaah, somebody was eavesdropping
on me talking to myself, how embarrassing!{w}You get killy-killed too~"{w}
note: bukkoropii (cutesy 'beat to death') -> 'killy-kill'.

en: "Good day to you."{w}
note: Farewell (gokigenyou) when the party leaves.

en: "Then you shall die."{w}
"Hmph, fools who think strength is everything...{w}I will not allow you to defile the Princess any further!{w}Even at the cost of my life, I shall see you off this stage!!"{w}
note: taijou shite itadaku = make them exit (stage metaphor kept).

en:
"So you have finally come to understand the Princess...
no, to understand yourselves.{w}Now, how do you intend to make amends for all your rudeness?"{w}{p}"At present, this land has been invaded by the Kin of Darkness.{w}Drive every last one of them out.{w}That is the only atonement you are capable of."{w}

"Not bad.
Every one of those loathsome presences has gone silent.{w}...Thank you for helping."{w}
*  Catacombs  *
note: Area label.
Encounter title banner. hazama no tamashii = 'souls of the in-between' (glossary).

en:
The thing that had begun to faintly appear before your eyes
started drawing in "something" around it
as it took on solid form.{w}{p}You held out, but if you are caught like this,
it will come to the same thing.{w}
note: Inner corner brackets around 'nanika' -> double quotes.

en: "Th-that was... the Abyss...!?"{w}{p}"That overwhelming presence of 'death'...{w}It's like the god of Dark Oblivion...{w}No... I can't stop shaking..."{w}
note: shin'en = 'the Abyss'; anmetsu no kami = 'god of Dark Oblivion'.
Encounter title banner. inou-gui = eater of (supernatural) abilities.
Encounter title banner; source English kept (full-width -> ASCII).

en: One Who Looks Down
note: Glossary form; 18 chars, over the ~16 name-box guideline.

kanojo = Urna. The source says kare no kawari ('his replacement') for Zeshrom; rendered 'fill in for Zeshrom' per the glossary's no-pronoun rule -- the lead may want 'his' here since the source states it. [editorial] source kare no kawari: Zeshrom = he (glossary male).
Encounter title banner; source English kept.

en: Strange Creature
"Well...{w}NYOPPing away there.{w}It might be safe."{w}
note: Source English kept as written (full-width -> ASCII).

en: Mysterious Little Girl
note: Glossary form; 22 chars, over the ~16 name-box guideline.

en: "Found you!"{w}
"NYOOOOOPS!?"{w}
note: Source English kept.

en: "Heeere goes... KABOOM!!"{w}
"Nyo... PUGYUuuuuu~~..."{w}
note: Source text kept.

en: "I did it again!{w}Jiggly-wiggly tummy.{w}This is fun!"{w}
note: purinpurin (jiggly) also sets up the 'PRIN' pun in 4890.

en: "NO MORE BOMB!{w}NO MORE NYOP!!{w}WE'RE PRIN NYOS! OK!?"{w}
note: Source English kept as written.
